title: SpecEngineeringBench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Autonomous Specification Engineers
abstract: arXiv:2611.32973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous specification engineering requires coding agents to translate functional requirements into executable tests and use the results to discover and validate defects. However, existing benchmarks evaluate coding agents on explicitly specified test generation tasks, commonly providing an issue description, a designated test entry point, or files to inspect, leaving the ability to determine what to test and where to investigate insufficiently evaluated. Relying on such clues bypasses the challenge of mapping requirements to implementations and proactively uncovering unknown defects. We propose SpecEngineeringBench, comprising 100 instances from 78 open-source Python repositories across 16 application categories, with multiple recorded defects in each instance. translated_title: SpecEngineeringBench：将编码智能体评估为自主规格工程师
translated_abstract: 自主规格工程要求编码智能体将功能需求转化为可执行的测试，并利用测试结果来发现和验证缺陷。然而，现有的基准在评估编码智能体时针对的是明确指定的测试生成任务，通常提供问题描述、指定的测试入口点或需要检查的文件，这使得“确定测试什么以及在何处调查”的能力未能得到充分评估。依赖此类线索绕过了将需求映射到实现并主动发现未知缺陷的挑战。我们提出了 SpecEngineeringBench，它包含来自16个应用类别的78个开源 Python 仓库的100个实例，每个实例包含多个已记录的缺陷。两个独立任务评估互补的能力：生成测试套件，以及通过执行分析发现缺陷。该评估结合了测试有效性、缺陷（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了 SpecEngineeringBench 基准，通过从78个开源 Python 仓库构建的100个实例，以测试套件生成和缺陷发现两项独立任务，评估编码智能体在缺乏明确线索的情况下自主将功能需求转化为测试并主动发现缺陷的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SpecEngineeringBench, a benchmark of 100 instances from 78 open-source Python repositories that evaluates coding agents' ability to autonomously translate functional requirements into executable tests and proactively uncover defects through two complementary tasks: test suite generation and defect discovery.
